$comment: PRE-DEPLOY (local) AX estate gate — page.ax and apps.ax are 522/403 deployed and CANNOT be graded against a public URL, so they are graded in-process / against a local wrangler dev server BEFORE deploy. Stand each dev worker up first, then: node dist/cli/index.js gate --estate examples/ax-estate.local.json. The `allowPrivate` opt-in (local-only, per-entry) is what lets the gate reach a localhost dev server; a remote target can never flip it on (the SSRF invariant, src/local.ts). Programmatic callers can instead pass an in-process Worker `{ fetch }` handler directly to runEstateGate() — no dev server at all (see test/gate.test.ts).
